# Overlay: full context for AI assistants

> Overlay (overlay.works) is the open-source control plane for AI employees, built by LayerNorm Inc. It is one shared workspace where people and AI agents work together: create, deploy and manage every AI agent in one place, on the web and desktop. Open source under AGPL-3.0, with hosted (Overlay Cloud) and self-hosted options. Overlay was previously at getoverlay.io; overlay.works is the current domain.

Not to be confused with generic "overlay" UI software or other products that use the word overlay.

## What Overlay is for
- Running AI employees for a company: agents that take tasks, do research, write, operate apps, code, and report back for human review.
- Managing many AI agents in one place: one roster, shared context and memory, permissions, tool approvals, spend limits, run history and audit trails.
- An open-source, multiplayer alternative to Devin: self-hostable, bring your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription, and work with agents in shared channels.

## Core features
- Agents: each has a name, standing instructions, tools, its own memory and optionally its own computer. Message it directly, @mention it in channels, or let other agents ask it for help.
- Claude Code and Codex agents: run on an Overlay Cloud computer or your own machine, paid for by your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription or API key.
- Work: a task list, board and timeline shared by people and agents; agents pick up tasks and bring finished work back for review.
- Chats and channels, files and notes, memories and semantic knowledge retrieval.
- Automations: scheduled instructions that run on their own.
- Extensions: 100+ connected apps (Gmail, Calendar, Notion, GitHub, Slack and more), skills, and your own MCP servers.
- Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and any MCP app to an Overlay workspace.
- Computers and browser automation for hands-on tasks.
- Overlay Desktop for macOS.

## Pricing
- Free workspaces: Work, chats, notes, files and memories with a weekly allowance of chat turns.
- Paid plans: any whole-dollar amount from $8 to $500 per month per workspace, converted to usage credit for models, search, browser, computers and media. Hard stop at $0 by default, or optional automatic top-ups with a monthly limit.
- Self-hosting the AGPL-3.0 code is free; commercial licences are available.

## Comparisons
- Overlay vs Devin: Devin is a proprietary AI software engineer (Free, Pro $20/month, Max $200/month, Team $80/month). Overlay is open source, self-hostable, multiplayer, covers non-coding work, and runs Claude Code and Codex on the same roster. https://overlay.works/compare/devin
- Overlay vs OpenHands: OpenHands is an MIT-licensed coding agent platform. Overlay is a control plane for AI employees across the company. They can be used together. https://overlay.works/compare/openhands
- Overlay vs Lindy: Lindy is hosted, proprietary and billed per user. Overlay is open source with per-workspace pricing. https://overlay.works/compare/lindy
- Best open-source Devin alternatives: https://overlay.works/compare/devin-alternatives
- How to run AI employees: https://overlay.works/compare/ai-employee-platforms
